badge.name: Badge
badge.note: Icon and text, always both. Born in the Table and used outside it.

banner.name: Banner
banner.note: A message in the flow, four severities. Info is called Info and painted neutral.

brand.name: Brand
brand.note: Logo, variants, backgrounds, minimum size, clear space and misuse.

button.name: Button
button.note: Five variants, three sizes, a square icon-only box and the double-submit guard.

cards.name: Card
cards.note: Two uses under one name: an option inside a group, a container outside it. The injector decides.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.note: An 18×18 box with a third, indeterminate state, for “select all”.

colors.name: Colour
colors.note: Primitive and semantic tokens, with the contrast worked out live.

datePicker.name: Date picker
datePicker.note: A date or a period in the app’s language, typed or picked with the keyboard. ISO value.

favorites.name: Favourites
favorites.note: The star and the fixed block in the sidebar. In memory until the Security Core exists.

icons.name: Iconography
icons.note: A closed catalogue of 71 Tabler icons, with the stroke compensated by size.

input.name: Input
input.note: Five types, FormValueControl<string>, and the height it shares with the Button of the same size.

modal.name: Modal / Dialog
modal.note: A confirmation as a promise and a form as a component, on top of the CDK dialog.

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.note: Rail, tabs and breadcrumbs, in step and without a router. The bottom bar, with its cost written down.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.note: Previous, next and where you are. A component of its own: the table is just its first consumer.

patternEmpty.name: Empty state
patternEmpty.note: One component, four cases: nothing there, no match, failed, no permission. The table and the select pick it themselves.

patternFilters.name: Filters
patternFilters.note: Screen filters that go to the source and live in the URL; the chips are the table’s.

patternForm.name: Form
patternForm.note: Validate on leaving a field and on submit, an error summary, Ctrl+S and unsaved changes. Save is never disabled.

patternKeyboard.name: Keyboard shortcuts
patternKeyboard.note: Registration by action, a single listener, and the scanner burst that triggers nothing.

patternSearchCreateEdit.name: Search, create, edit
patternSearchCreateEdit.note: The sample screen: the click budget, measured live on components that already existed.

radio.name: Radio
radio.note: The same box as the Checkbox, grouped by the native name and with no third state.

select.name: Select
select.note: The only picker, and it always searches: in memory it filters as you type; with a source it pages and resolves a scan.

spacing.name: Spacing, radii and elevation
spacing.note: A base of 4, the five radii, the three control heights and the three shadows.

splitButton.name: Split button
splitButton.note: A main action and its alternatives one click away: “Download / PDF / Excel / CSV”. The menu is the Table’s.

table.name: Data table
table.note: Declared columns, a flattened tree, filters by type and the keyboard of a treegrid.

text.name: Text
text.note: The seven semantic variants, and why the visual level is not split from the document level.

toast.name: Toast
toast.note: A shared queue with a single live region. It is a service, not a tag.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.note: A 44×24 track with a 20 thumb. It applies on touch: if there is a Save next to it, it should be a Checkbox.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.note: A directive, not a component. The three rules of 1.4.13 and the trap of the name disabled.

typography.name: Typography
typography.note: Montserrat and the H1-H4 / P / Caption / Mono scale, at actual size.
